title: Linux & Ubuntu
summary: Getting comfortable with the command line and the foundations of a Linux environment.
goal: Practise a small system task using the terminal, file permissions, and helpful command documentation.

title: Docker
summary: Exploring how containers make applications easier to run in a consistent development environment.
goal: Containerise a small application and practise running it with ports and a development volume.

title: Flutter
summary: Learning the building blocks of mobile interfaces and application development with Flutter.
goal: Create a small mobile interface and understand how its screens and application logic fit together.

title: Cybersecurity
summary: Building an understanding of security fundamentals and how they relate to software development.
goal: Recognise common security risks and practise applying basic security thinking to an academic project.
